correctness.rationale: The bounded-morphism successor-image equality is derived directly. Mutual accessibility forces a constant target cluster on each source cluster; forward preservation makes its cluster map monotone. The root successor-image condition forces onto a target suffix. A last-source-block surjection is both necessary and sufficient for every successor cone, yielding the exact product. Idempotents fix their image, force all lower clusters into the boundary target cluster, and are counted independently. Binomial and geometric consequences are exact. The standalone exhaustive brute checker compares 3,192,243 function tables over 65 frame profiles and separate direct algebra operations. Finite experiments supplement rather than prove the uniform theorem.

value.rationale: The frame class is the natural finite reflexive linear-preorder subclass of S4.3: chains with arbitrarily sized modal equivalence clusters. The complete image-rank census is nontrivial for unequal sizes because a target cluster needs surjection from the last source cluster in each compressed block. The uniform specialization produces a closed binomial distribution for a randomly sampled bounded endomorphism and an exact exponential decay law for idempotents, useful quantitative statistics not provided by general duality or a bare finite-model property. This is a natural complete classification rather than a hand-chosen small instance.
